annotations.title: Search sports events / Szukaj meczów i gal

description: Search upcoming ticketed sports events in Poland listed on KiedySport.pl: league and national team matches, tournaments, MMA and boxing nights. Filters (all optional, combine freely): discipline, city, club, venue, date_from/date_to or a `when` shortcut, free-text query. Returns up to 20 events per call (page with offset and next_offset) with date, start time or "wkrótce", venue, city, price from (only when known) and the event page link, plus total_found. Default range: from today on. Example call: {"discipline":"siatkowka"} or {"city":"Warszawa","discipline":"siatkowka"}. / Szukaj meczów i gal z biletami: dyscyplina, miasto (także bez polskich znaków), klub, hala, daty, fraza.

city.description: Polish city, with or without Polish letters, e.g. "Kraków" or "Krakow". / Miasto.

club.description: Club or team name, short forms accepted (e.g. "Stal Mielec" for "Handball Stal Mielec"). / Klub.

discipline.description: Sport slug (see list_disciplines). Names like "volleyball", "siatkówka", "MMA" are accepted too. / Dyscyplina.

offset.description: Skip this many matches; use next_offset from the previous page.

query.description: Words from the event title, team or venue, e.g. "KSW", "Puchar Polski". / Fraza.

venue.description: Arena, hall or stadium name. / Hala lub stadion.

when.description: Date shortcut (Europe/Warsaw); this_weekend = Friday to Sunday of the current week. Overrides date_from/date_to.

name: search_events

ok.description: true = the tool ran (also when nothing was found; read status).
